ValidationRule.description: Prevents modification of the original requested change facts after an Employment Change Item leaves Draft status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Item_Status__c, "Draft")), OR( ISCHANGED(Change_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Requested_Value__c), ISCHANGED(Requested_Effective_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Requested_Work_Location__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requested change details cannot be modified after the Employment Change Item has been submitted.
